lenses.label: Horálek optical
lenses.title: Petr Horálek’s visible-light LMC
lenses.description: Optical photograph colours are painted onto the shared image-fitted LMC emission model. Its broad envelope keeps the shape of the Garver et al. stellar simulation; depth is not measured gas or dust. Catalogue-star positions are observed; their modeled depths do not establish individual distances. The reference image shows the photograph before star removal and 3D emission fitting.
lenses.summary: Optical photograph colours on an image-fitted emission model; gas and dust depth are not measured.

facts.label: Depth
facts.value: Image-fitted emission on a simulated stellar-density envelope

lenses.label: ESO VISTA
lenses.title: LMC in near infrared
lenses.description: Near-infrared colours from ESO's VISTA survey are painted onto the shared image-fitted LMC emission model. Its broad envelope keeps the shape of the Garver et al. stellar simulation; depth is not measured gas or dust. All lenses share one opacity, so this lens renders brighter than its own image. Catalogue-star positions are observed; their modeled depths do not establish individual distances. The reference image shows the photograph before star removal and 3D emission fitting.
lenses.summary: Near-infrared false colour on an image-fitted emission model; gas and dust depth are not measured.

facts.value: Image-fitted emission on a simulated stellar-density envelope

lenses.label: NASA AllWISE
lenses.title: LMC in WISE infrared
lenses.description: Infrared colours from the NASA/IPAC AllWISE mosaic are painted onto the shared image-fitted LMC emission model. Its broad envelope keeps the shape of the Garver et al. stellar simulation; depth is not measured gas or dust. All lenses share one opacity, so this lens renders much brighter than its own image. Catalogue-star positions are observed; their modeled depths do not establish individual distances. The reference image shows the photograph before star removal and 3D emission fitting.
lenses.summary: AllWISE infrared false colour on an image-fitted emission model; gas and dust depth are not measured.
